How to use

Simply slide your ID card, photo, or small keepsake into the holder's slot to keep it protected and visible. Carry it in your bag, pocket, or use it on your desk to display your favorite memories or identification with style. Avoid overstuffing the holder to maintain its shape and functionality.

Care instructions

Clean the photo holder gently with a soft, damp cloth to remove dirt or dust. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials that could damage the plastic surface. Store in a dry place away from direct sunlight to prevent fading or warping.
